components.css: .ds-pane{overflow:hidden;border:1px solid var(--color-line);border-radius:12px;background:var(--color-pane);box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 var(--color-sheen)}.ds-split{display:grid;grid-template-columns:2fr 3fr}.ds-split>div:first-child{border-right:1px solid var(--color-line)}.ds-report-side{background:var(--color-page)}.ds-pane-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:10px 16px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--color-line);font:400 12px var(--font-mono);color:var(--color-muted)}.ds-chip-f{border-radius:9999px;padding:2px 8px;background:var(--color-failure-bg);color:var(--color-failure);font-weight:500}.ds-diff,.ds-report{margin:0;padding:12px 0;font:400 13px/1.75 var(--font-mono);white-space:pre-wrap}.ds-diff span{display:grid;grid-template-columns:2ch 1fr;gap:8px;padding:0 16px;color:var(--color-secondary)}.ds-diff i{font-style:normal;color:var(--color-muted)}.ds-diff b{font-weight:400}.ds-diff .rm{background:var(--color-failure-bg)}.ds-diff .rm i{color:var(--color-failure)}.ds-diff .rm b{opacity:.7}.ds-report{padding:12px 16px;color:var(--color-secondary)}.ds-report .m{color:var(--color-muted)}.ds-report .p{color:var(--color-primary)}.ds-report .f{color:var(--color-failure)}@media (max-width:900px){.ds-split{grid-template-columns:1fr}.ds-split>div:first-child{border-right:0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--color-line)}}

narrative.overview:
The developer-tool category standard, played straight and finished to a high craft bar. A pure black ground, near-black panes edged by hairlines, near-white type, and nothing that glows. The product proves itself with real artefacts: YAML contracts shown as diffs, `can-i-deploy` reports with their exit codes, real SDK code. Decoration never stands in for evidence.

Density is calm on the marketing surface (wide section padding, centered hero, one 1120px column) and tighter inside panes, where monospace text runs at 13px with generous line height so a report reads like a terminal. Docs share every token and component; they only swap the centered marketing column for a sidebar, article and table of contents.

Color carries meaning only once: green and red belong to the deploy verdict. Everything else is a step on the grey ladder, with white as the single accent for focus, selection, active state and link underlines.
keyCharacteristics: Pure black page, near-black panes, 1px translucent white hairlines.
White is the only accent; no hue outside the verdict pair.
Bricolage Grotesque for headings, Geist Sans for prose and controls, Geist Mono for anything a machine reads.
Real contracts and real command output as the imagery.
Flat depth: tonal steps plus a 1px inner top sheen, no drop shadows.

rules.name: The Verdict-Only Color Rule
rules.body: Green and red appear only where a deploy verdict, an exit code, or a contract diff says pass or break. They never decorate a heading, an icon, a button or a status that is not a verdict.

rules.name: The One White Rule
rules.body: The only accent is white. Emphasis comes from moving up the grey ladder (muted, secondary, primary, accent), never from adding a hue.

rules.name: The Machine Text Rule
rules.body: Anything a machine reads or writes (a command, a file name, a YAML line, a report, an exit code) is Geist Mono. Prose about it is Geist Sans.

rules.name: The Display Is For Headings Rule
rules.body: Bricolage sets page and section headings and the site wordmark, nothing else: never body, buttons or labels.

rules.name: The No Glow Rule
rules.body: No drop shadows, no colored glows, no gradients behind content. A surface is separated from its ground by one tonal step and a hairline.

dos: Do separate every surface from its ground with one tonal step plus a 1px Hairline (rgba(255,255,255,0.08)).
Do show the product with real contracts, real `can-i-deploy` output and real SDK code, in Geist Mono.
Do keep green and red to verdicts, exit codes and diff rows.
Do step emphasis up the grey ladder (Ash, Smoke, Ink, Signal White) instead of adding color.
Do keep 16px side gutters and reflow (stack, wrap, relabel) rather than scroll sideways.
Do give every pressable the 0.97 press scale and fine-pointer-only hover.
donts: Don't introduce a second accent hue; white is the only accent.
Don't add drop shadows, glows or gradients; the inner Sheen is the only shadow.
Don't set body, labels or buttons in Bricolage Grotesque.
Don't invent customers, logos, testimonials or usage numbers as social proof.
Don't use icon fonts or emoji as icons; arrows are inline SVG strokes, and the 🤝 mark is the brand mark only.
